description:
As a customer, I want to change my cart before checking out.

* Increasing the quantity of an item updates that line's total and the cart total.
* Removing an item removes it from the list and updates the total.
* Removing the last item shows an empty cart message.
* Cart contents persist after a page refresh.

criteria.text: Increasing the quantity of an item updates that line's total and the cart total.
Removing an item removes it from the list and updates the total.
Removing the last item shows an empty cart message.
Cart contents persist after a page refresh.

cases.title: Increasing the quantity of an item updates the line total and the cart total
cases.preconditions: A customer is on the shopping cart page with at least one item in the cart, with quantity 1. The line total and the cart total are noted before the change.
steps: Note the current quantity, the line total of the item and the cart total.
Increase the quantity of the item (for example from 1 to 2).
Observe the item's line total.
Observe the cart total.
cases.expected: The item's line total is updated to reflect the increased quantity, and the cart total is updated accordingly.

cases.title: Increasing the quantity of one item in a cart with several items updates the cart total
cases.preconditions: A customer is on the shopping cart page with at least two different items in the cart.
steps: Note the line total of each item and the cart total.
Increase the quantity of the first item.
Observe the line total of the first item.
Observe the line total of the second item.
Observe the cart total.
cases.expected: The first item's line total is updated to reflect the increased quantity, the second item's line total is unchanged, and the cart total is updated accordingly.

cases.title: Removing an item from a cart with several items removes it and updates the total
cases.preconditions: A customer is on the shopping cart page with at least two different items in the cart.
steps: Note the items listed and the cart total.
Remove one of the items from the cart.
Observe the list of items.
Observe the cart total.
cases.expected: The removed item is no longer in the list, the remaining item(s) are still listed, and the cart total is updated.

cases.title: Removing the last item shows an empty cart message
cases.preconditions: A customer is on the shopping cart page with exactly one item in the cart.
steps: Remove the only item from the cart.
Observe the cart page.
cases.expected: The item is removed from the list and an empty cart message is shown (the exact wording of the message is not specified in the story).

cases.title: Cart contents persist after a page refresh
cases.preconditions: A customer is on the shopping cart page with at least two items in the cart, with known quantities and totals.
steps: Note the items, their quantities, their line totals and the cart total.
Refresh the page.
Observe the items, their quantities, their line totals and the cart total.
cases.expected: The same items, quantities, line totals and cart total are shown after the refresh.

cases.title: Cart changes persist after a page refresh
cases.preconditions: A customer is on the shopping cart page with at least two items in the cart, each with quantity 1.
steps: Increase the quantity of one item.
Remove another item from the cart.
Note the items, their quantities, their line totals and the cart total.
Refresh the page.
Observe the items, their quantities, their line totals and the cart total.
cases.expected: After the refresh the cart still shows the increased quantity, the removed item is still absent, and the line totals and cart total match the values noted before the refresh.
